summary: A1 triage of ep 7 (filler, manual ch-7 anchor). D4's working assumption ('typed filler while adapting ch 7 by exact match') is wrong: The Silent's infobox re-confirms batch15 - captured ep = Episode 7 but captured ch = N/A, and the card is one of the 'fifty-three Clow Cards in the anime' (the manga captures nineteen) - so the museum/Silent capture body is wholly anime-original. The episode's only manga content is its closing tag: Syaoran's debut cameo atop the museum sensing a Clow Card = ch 7's final page, while ch 7's sports-day body is adapted in ep 10. The filler type is Sean's own batch15 override and stands; what violates A1 is batch15's 1-page sliver anchor, which the 2026-08-24 sliver ruling (<=~5 pages -> annotation facts only) now forbids. Repair nulls it; the annotation below preserves the cameo fact so it survives the anchor's removal. AFL is no counter-evidence: it coarsely lumps eps 1-11 as canon and was already discredited on eps 4-5 in batch14.

Manual-source anchor, no re-derive risk.
